name: Fritillary
description: Butterflies with spotted wings fluttering at tilted angles, scattered over the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--wings); clip-path: @var(--wings); -webkit-transform: translate(@r(-8, 8)%, @r(-8, 8)%) rotate(@calc(@rn(-40, 40, 3) + @r(-15, 15))deg) scale(@r(0.95, 1.2)); transform: translate(@r(-8, 8)%, @r(-8, 8)%) rotate(@calc(@rn(-40, 40, 3) + @r(-15, 15))deg) scale(@r(0.95, 1.2)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(9% 9% at 26% 36%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(9% 9% at 74% 36%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(6% 6% at 34% 68%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(6% 6% at 66% 68%, #000 100%, transparent 100%); mask: radial-gradient(9% 9% at 26% 36%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(9% 9% at 74% 36%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(6% 6% at 34% 68%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(6% 6% at 66% 68%, #000 100%, transparent 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 47%; width: 6%; top: 26%; height: 52%; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color1); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
